title: Measures to Control Wild Bird Populations in HDB Estates
what_it_is: Measures to Control Wild Bird Populations in HDB Estates

sections.label: AVA wild bird control measures
sections.summary: AVA works with Town Councils on measures like bird deterrent gels and fogging trees to control wild birds in HDB estates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The Agri-Food and Veterinary Authority of Singapore (AVA) adopts a multi-pronged approach to controlling the population of wild birds like crows, mynahs and pigeons in our Housing and Development Board (HDB) estates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: First, AVA works with Town Councils to implement measures to mitigate issues caused by birds, and this includes using bird deterrent gels and fogging trees to discourage birds from roosting near our residential areas.

sections.label: AVA wild bird disease surveillance
sections.summary: AVA conducts regular surveillance of wild birds for diseases, and no diseases of concern have been detected in common bird species.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: AVA also conducts regular surveillance of wild birds to detect diseases and thus far, there has been no detection of diseases of concern in the common bird species.

sections.label: Sonic bird deterrent effects temporary
sections.summary: AVA considered sonic systems to deter birds but notes effects are usually temporary as birds acclimatise to the sound.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: AVA has considered the suggestion to use sonic systems to deter birds.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: However, we must be aware that the effects are usually temporary and the birds have been known to acclimatise to the sound.

sections.label: Tree species and bird deterrence trials
sections.summary: AVA will refer specific tree types to NParks and is trialling fogging and deterrent gels, weighing efficacy and cost-effectiveness for Town Councils.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: If there are specific tree types that do attract a certain particular species of birds, we can take this back to the National Parks Board and see if there are options to look at the species of trees in our housing estates.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Beyond that, what AVA is trying to do is also to adopt certain trials to see whether there ways in which, regardless of how many trees we change, sometimes the birds just have some way of going to a particular tree.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, they are trying things like fogging methods, deterrent gels and some of these trials may take some time to mature before we know whether the method is efficacious.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: More importantly, it has to be cost-effective because at the end of the day, this involves extra spending by Town Councils which means conservancy charges will have to be taken in account, on how the money is being spent as well.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: At the end of the day we will explore science-based methods to see whether there are newer ways to deter the birds but immediately if you can recognise a certain species of trees, please let us know, we can get NParks to take a look as well.
